event.text: I recommend being seen in person today — urgent care or an emergency department — for your worsening COPD symptoms. Being winded just walking to the bathroom, along with green phlegm, needs oxygen measurement, a lung exam and likely a chest X-ray that can't be done by message. Call 911 now if you become breathless at rest, cannot speak full sentences, turn blue, or become confused or drowsy. A Counsel clinician can follow up in this thread afterward.
